name: Taipei 101 Observatory
desc: Reach the 89th floor in 37 seconds! Enjoy a 360° view over the bustling Taipei Basin, with breathtaking sunsets and a million sparkling city lights at night.

name: Jiufen Old Street & A-Mei Teahouse
desc: Stroll the winding stone steps as red lanterns light up at dusk, sip tea at A-Mei Teahouse overlooking Keelung's hills and sea, and enjoy a bowl of fresh taro balls.

name: National Palace Museum
badge: One of the World's Four Great Museums
desc: Home to nearly 700,000 imperial treasures spanning 5,000 years of Chinese history, including the astonishing Jadeite Cabbage and Meat-Shaped Stone—a must-see for any visitor to Taiwan.

name: Keelung Zhengbin Fishing Harbor Rainbow Houses
desc: A row of old fishing-harbor buildings painted in bright macaron colors reflects on the shimmering water, with the aroma of charcoal-grilled fish paste drifting from nearby.

name: Daxi Old Street Baroque Architecture, Taoyuan
desc: On Heping Old Street, wash-gravel carved facades blend Greek pediments with Chinese auspicious motifs. Feast on hot braised black dried tofu and handmade peanut candy.

name: Smangus, Hsinchu
desc: An Atayal sanctuary nestled in deep mountain mist, where towering millennia-old cypress trees inspire awe and the night sky blazes with stars.

name: Shengxing Station & Broken Bridge, Sanyi, Miaoli
desc: The highest point of the western mainline railway! An all-wood Japanese station, a rail-bike ride through a rainbow tunnel, and a view of the century-old red-brick broken bridge.

name: National Taichung Theater
badge: One of the World's Nine New Landmarks
desc: A stunning Pritzker Prize-winning work by Toyo Ito! A beamless cave-like curved-wall design, with a sixth-floor sky garden overlooking Taichung's upscale skyline.

name: Gaomei Wetland Sunset & Windmills, Taichung
desc: Walk to the end of the long wooden boardwalk, step barefoot into the cool soft mud, and watch giant wind turbines and a sky full of sunset colors reflected on the water.

name: Lukang Old Street & the Lane of Nine Turns
desc: First Tainan, second Lukang, third Bangka! The Lane of Nine Turns stays warm in winter and cool in summer, the Half Well reflects neighborly warmth, and Mazu Temple's incense burns eternal.

name: Sun Moon Lake Cycling Loop, Nantou
badge: One of the World's Ten Most Beautiful Bike Paths
desc: Cycle into the breeze along an elevated lakeside bike path, admiring the Shuishe Dam and the pure-white minimalist Xiangshan Visitor Center blending with the emerald water.

name: Qingjing Farm Green Green Grassland, Nantou
desc: A lush alpine ranch nearly 2,000 meters up, where flocks of white sheep graze leisurely. Walk the skywalk for sweeping views of Hehuanshan's majestic sea of clouds.

name: Huashan Coffee Park, Gukeng, Yunlin
desc: The heartland of Taiwan-grown coffee! Enjoy sweeping views over the Chianan Plain, local Arabica roasts, and dazzling night views stretching across seven cities and counties.

name: Alishan Forest Railway & Giant Trees, Chiayi
desc: Ride the little red train as it spirals up the mountain through the clouds, then stroll the shaded boardwalk among millennia-old red cypress trees, breathing in the natural phytoncides.

name: Chimei Museum & Apollo Fountain, Tainan
desc: Greek marble sculptures, the Apollo Chariot fountain, a world-class violin collection, and classical Western paintings—as if stepping into the Palace of Versailles.

name: Anping Fort & Old Street Tree House, Tainan
desc: Witness 400 years of Taiwanese history! A century-old banyan's aerial roots engulf an entire warehouse; stroll Anping Old Street for shrimp rolls, oyster omelets, and tofu pudding.

name: Pier-2 Art Center & Great Harbor Bridge, Kaohsiung
desc: Old harbor salt and sugar warehouses transformed into a major contemporary art venue; the 3 p.m. opening of Taiwan's first rotating Great Harbor Bridge is a highlight.

name: Cijin Rainbow Church & Black Sand Beach, Kaohsiung
desc: A breezy 5-minute ferry ride gets you there! The geometric rainbow church on the water, big ships sailing into port, and fresh seafood from the seafood street.

name: Houbihu Snorkeling & Water Sports, Kenting, Pingtung
desc: Taiwan's best-preserved coral reefs! Guided by a professional instructor, dive into the azure water and get up close with schools of clownfish.

name: Vase Rock & Swimming with Sea Turtles, Xiaoliuqiu, Pingtung
desc: Taiwan's only coral island! With exceptional water visibility, glide on a clear SUP or snorkel and encounter adorable giant green sea turtles all around.

name: Jiaoxi Hot Springs & Tangweigou Park, Yilan
desc: A colorless, odorless sodium bicarbonate spring that leaves your skin silky-smooth! Tangweigou Park has a free outdoor foot-soaking pool and the quirky fun of doctor fish.

name: Wushi Harbor Surfing, Toucheng, Yilan
desc: Northern Taiwan's most famous surfing playground! A long gentle black-sand beach, views of mysterious Guishan Island, and easy waves perfect for beginners.

name: Taroko Gorge & Swallow Grotto Trail, Hualien
desc: A natural marble geology museum sculpted over millions of years! Look up at thousand-meter cliffs piercing the sky, carved by the rushing white water of the Liwu River.

name: Qingshui Cliff Sunrise SUP, Hualien
desc: Paddle out of Chongde Bay on a SUP and witness the golden sun burst from the horizon over the calm Pacific, lighting up thousand-meter vertical cliffs.

name: Chishang Brown Avenue Golden Rice Fields, Taitung
desc: A pristine green canvas with not a single utility pole in sight! In autumn it turns into endless golden rice fields—rent an electric cart and cruise the valley breeze.

name: Luye Gaotai Balloon Festival, Taitung
desc: Overlook the checkerboard tea gardens and farmland of the Beinan River valley from on high! In summer, dozens of giant balloons rise at dawn and dusk; try paragliding for true freedom.

name: Qimei Double-Heart Stone Weir & Little Taiwan, Penghu
desc: A tidal fish trap built from basalt and coral reveals a perfect heart shape at low tide, with crystal-clear blue water—a romantic haven for couples.

name: Zhaishan Tunnel & Deyue Tower, Kinmen
desc: A military waterway hewn by hand from solid granite over five years! Step inside for superb natural acoustics, with the still water reflecting the rock walls in serene beauty.

name: Beihai Tunnel & Blue Tears, Matsu
desc: Ride a traditional wooden rowboat into a pitch-dark tunnel waterway; each stroke of the oar stirs the water and bioluminescent organisms glow a dreamy blue—like another planet.

name: Shifen Waterfall & Sky Lanterns, Pingxi, New Taipei
desc: Write your New Year's wish in the middle of the railway and watch colorful sky lanterns rise into the blue sky! Then visit the powerful 20-meter Shifen Waterfall.

name: Chenghuang Temple & East Gate Market, Hsinchu
desc: The highest-ranked Chenghuang Temple in Taiwan! Outside, century-old Guo's spring rolls, Xu's duck, and rice noodles with meatballs; a short walk links to the hip late-night eateries of East Gate Market.

name: Nanliao Fishing Harbor & Fish-Scale Stairs, Hsinchu
desc: White fish-scale-shaped wave breakers stretch into the sea; cycle the 17-km coastline, savor fresh-grilled seafood at the market, and watch the Taiwan Strait's stunning sunset.

name: Hinoki Village & Beimen Station, Chiayi
desc: Taiwan's largest Japanese-era official residence complex! 29 century-old Alishan cypress machiya houses are fully preserved, offering kimono experiences, Fuyishan egg-roll souvenirs, and a journey to the Alishan Forest Railway's starting point.

name: Wenhua Road Night Market & Fountain Roundabout, Chiayi
tag: City That Never Sleeps for Food
desc: Featured on Netflix's Street Food! Enjoy Lin's smart fish-head casserole, Chef Ahong's turkey rice, Yuxiangwu grapefruit green tea, and cube pastries for the most authentic Zhuluo flavor.
